title: Dinosaurs: Rulers of the Ancient World
description: Teeth, giants, and the day the rulers fell—dino facts for curious minds.

questions.question: How long were T-Rex teeth?
questions.hint: About as long as a banana

questions.question: Which dinosaur had over 500 teeth?
questions.hint: A living lawn mower of tiny teeth

questions.question: Nigersaurus lived until what ended the dinosaurs 66 million years ago?
questions.hint: Something from space crashed into Earth

questions.question: After the asteroid, which long-necked dinosaur was longer than a school bus?
questions.hint: A giant plant-eater with a very long neck
